name: Ash-Skinned Courtesan
journal_prompt: An artificial, female humanoid sculpted from river mud and lotus pollen, which later mutated into a flesh-hungry night-stalker.
appearance: A tall, slender night-walker made of packed river mud, white ash and yellow pollen, wearing a veil of withered lotus fronds over a smooth, porcelain-like face that shifts subtly, like wet clay, when it is watched.
